shared_elements: carved/marked stone surface bearing figural imagery
justification: A shows flat, linear, schematic outline drawings — boat-like forms with rows of vertical crew strokes and other line figures spread over a rock panel — while B is a three-dimensional sculpted human head with modelled brow, eyes, nose and mouth. Beyond both being schematic rather than naturalistic renderings on stone, there is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement whatsoever.
